name: Leipzig Corpora Collection zho_news_2020_100K

licence.name: CC BY (per Leipzig terms of usage for downloadable corpora)
licence.method: The live terms page could not be fetched directly (anti-bot interstitial), so the Internet Archive snapshot 20260206070156 of that page was used. It states that the text corpora offered for download are made available under CC BY; the CC BY-NC clause on the same page applies to the web applications, not the downloads.

used_for: language model (bigram/trigram training pool) and name-model weight estimation; NOT used for evaluation. Same collection (news 2020) as the hash-split eval source zho_news_2020_10K — exact eval sentences are excluded from training, but near-duplicates from the shared crawl remain, which is why the source-separated test set exists (see scripts/build_eval_corpus.py --split-by).
redistribution: No. Fetched on demand into ~/.cache/biling-corpus/; the repository ships only aggregate n-gram statistics inside lexicon.sqlite3, never the text.
citation: D. Goldhahn, T. Eckart and U. Quasthoff: Building Large Monolingual Dictionaries at the Leipzig Corpora Collection. LREC 2012.
